inclasp.definition:

inclemency.definition:
n weather unsuitable for outdoor activities
n excessive sternness

inclement.definition:
a. (of weather or climate) severe
a. used of persons or behavior; showing no clemency or mercy
inclement.translation: a. 险恶的, 严酷的

inclinable.definition:
a. Leaning; tending.
a. Having a propensity of will or feeling; leaning in
   disposition; disposed; propense; as, a mind inclinable to truth.

inclinableness.definition:
n. The state or quality of being inclinable;
   inclination.

inclination.definition:
n. an attitude of mind especially one that favors one alternative over others
n. (astronomy) the angle between the plane of the orbit and the plane of the ecliptic stated in degrees
n. (geometry) the angle formed by the x-axis and a given line (measured counterclockwise from the positive half of the x-axis)
n. that toward which you are inclined to feel a liking
inclination.translation:
n. 倾向, 趋向, 倾斜度, 点头
[化] 倾角

inclinations.translation: n. 倾向( inclination的复数形式 ); 倾斜; 爱好; 斜坡

inclinatory.definition:

inclinatory.translation: a. 倾向的；趋向的；偏爱的
